chapter_note: Dominantly core cosmological-mechanical exposition (Living Spirit’s three garments managing discharge/sweeping of the three dark vessels) expressed through extended correspondential analogies (doctor/medicines; child in womb/garments). Later compilation frame appears in the opening and in speech-attribution seams (¶1–2, ¶13), and a clear late application/pastoral drift appears in the second-half advantages list where the teaching is applied to contemporary human conditions ("today"), ascetic practice (fasting), and institutional roles (apostles).

paragraphs.core_text: Tell us, and instruct us about these three vessels that [ ... ] and were discharged from above, and how they were discharged and separated from all the rulers who are arranged in the heavens. For it is a necessity for us to know the manner in which the three vessels have been discharged, while the rulers were flourishing in their body.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic dialogue frame: “Once again the disciples questioned the enlightener, saying to him:” and the reverential address “our master,” as compilation-layer wrapping.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Substantive cosmological question (vessels discharged from rulers in the heavens) is teaching-structural; the narrative set-up ‘Once again… disciples… enlightener’ is compilation frame.

paragraphs.core_text: Happen you know, that when these vessels were discharged, they were discharged in [ ... ] slaughter, but those [ ... ] these vessels from them.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution and audience-address: “Then the enlightener speaks to his disciples:” and “my beloved ones,” as frame/application voice.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core begins after the speech tag, giving the mechanism of discharge; the initial ‘enlightener…to his disciples’ is an editorial container.

paragraphs.core_text: They are like the form of a man who has fallen into a purulent sickness. Other wounds and diseases are in his body, and even bile and other poisons are in his inner limbs. He achieves good health by a wise doctor, who gives him one remedy to drink that causes his purulent sickness to break out above, and gives him another medicine to drink that causes his sickness to discharge below, and he gives him yet another medicine to drink that cures his wounds for him [ ... ] calmly and silently.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Extended correspondential analogy (illness/poison ↔ hidden vessels; remedies ↔ purifying agents) stays internal to a cosmic-mechanical model; impersonal explanatory voice.

paragraphs.core_text: Through the skill of a wise doctor, with his effective medicines to consume that take away all sicknesses in this manner and dissolve all magic, the doctors shall [ ... ] they work cures through the aroma of the medicine, other wounds [ ... ] what is hidden, they at last tear them out from [ ... ] manifested above and below [ ... through] the aroma of edible medicines that were placed upon them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continuation of the same technical analogy (process-language, hidden/manifested, above/below discharge). “magic” here functions inside the medical simile rather than as polemic against contemporary practitioners.

paragraphs.core_text: This is also what these vessels of water, of darkness and of fire are like, which are hidden in the body of all the rulers above; while the Living Spirit is like the wise doctor. These three healing drugs are the three garments that the Living Spirit assumes upon his body: of wind, of water, and of fire. Through them he has set in order the things below. For by those three garments he has been displayed to the rulers who are above, with hard-heartedness, with shaking and fear, with derangement; from them he discharged the three vessels, those of water, of darkness and of fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Clear core mapping cosmos→cosmos: vessels (dark elements) embedded in rulers; Living Spirit’s three light ‘garments’ as operative instruments; systematic triadic structure and mechanism of discharge.

paragraphs.core_text: The case of these vessels is just like a child who is in his mother's womb and is swathed by seven garments. The first is the marrow, the second is the bones, the third is the tendons, the fourth is the flesh, the fifth the veins, the sixth the blood, the seventh the skin of the body that covers him. The other garment also [ ... / ... in the womb of his mother. His mother also is just like] this child. The marrow and the bones, the sinews and flesh, the veins and blood and skin, together with the garment that she wears and the linen that swathes her, total nine. Together with the nine of the child, these and the others, they shall complete and make eighteen garments. Now, you shall find the soul of this child is entwined within all these.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered anatomical layering (7/9/18 garments) is characteristic systematic correspondential teaching; second-person “you shall find” functions as explanatory rhetoric within the model, not institutional exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: And look see: When the smell of the action of the demon, which brings about the stench of birth, will reveal the child; immediately [ ... ] shall [ ... ] all [these things] and it emerges from a crack that has become visible, while no tear nor wound occurs in the body of the child. In the same way as this child opens up the womb of his mother, so is it also with these vessels of water, of darkness and of fire. The actions that open up his mother to the child, and she shakes him out and reveals him; these are the three living garments that the Living Spirit assumed on his body.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Correspondential birth-mechanics mapped directly to cosmic discharge-mechanics (garments as operative forces). No move toward contemporary institutions.

paragraphs.core_text: For by the aspect of the garment of water [ ... / ... ] from the rulers; he moved [ ... ] they are the poison and death with which their veins and entrails are filled.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic physiology applied to rulers (veins/entrails filled with poison/death) and the ‘aspect’ of the water-garment as the operative trigger—internal system description.

paragraphs.core_text: By the aspect of the garment of wind, in which he was revealed [ ... ] he has swept away and erased the entire destructive shadow and dirt, discharged it down to the earth. Afterwards he swept it out and confined it in the vessel of darkness that surrounds the universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Process sequence (reveal → sweep/discharge → sweep out → confine) is core cosmological mechanics; ‘vessel of darkness surrounding the universe’ is internal cosmic architecture.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, by the garment of living fire, through its splendour and vigour, he discharged the fire of the darkness from all the rulers and threw it down upon this earth. He swept it another time from the earth and confined it in the vessel that surrounds all the worlds, and they call it the wall of great fire.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Triadic garment-operation continues; ‘wall of great fire’ as cosmic boundary structure is core system vocabulary.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, those three garments, through which he established these three things, he did not peel them off all at once; but he stripped them off one by one at the appropriate time [ ... ] down to the earth [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Timing/sequence regulation (one-by-one at the appropriate time) is core ‘how it works’ mechanics, not moral application.

paragraphs.core_text: In this way the universe of the [ ... ... ] his vessels [ ... ] these vessels like [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fragmentary but continues the impersonal cosmological explanation; no frame/pastoral markers.

paragraphs.core_text: The use of the matter, and the management of these vessels that were swept out and discharged from above to earth, have brought an advantage and benefit of twelve great deeds. Afterwards, they were swept from the earth and pushed outside to the edges of the worlds and to the extremity.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed speech-attribution seam: “Furthermore, he continued. He says to his disciples:” as compilation-layer framing.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core introduces a structured twelvefold advantages list tied to cosmic management; the prefatory ‘he says to his disciples’ is editorial framing.

paragraphs.core_text: The first deed is this: So that evil-doing does not increase in the universe, neither in the creations nor in the trees [ ... it has set i]tself up in three things.
paragraphs.temporal_note: System-internal rationale (‘so that… in the universe… creations… trees’) for the cosmic management; still explanatory rather than hortatory.

paragraphs.core_text: The [first is / ...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Too lacunose to evaluate further; no overt late-layer markers.

paragraphs.core_text: The second is error [ ... ... ] For, if it were so, if [the vessel of water] had not been swept down from above, but rather the waters existing up till now in the rulers above [ ... / ... the] torrents that would flow [ ... ] and the droplets that would [ ... ] down, so lust would have sprouted [ ... i]n the trees and in the fruits as well as all flesh [ ... ] down [ ... / ... ]
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed direct address/meta-discourse (“Indeed, about this I have spoken to you…”) and the present-anchored, human-society application beginning with “today … you could not find a single person … a saint …” as cosmos→contemporary-world pointing.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Starts as core counterfactual cosmological mechanics (what would happen if the water-vessel remained in rulers), then pivots to editorial present (‘today’) and moral/institutional exempla (‘saint’).

paragraphs.core_text: Not only this, but if the vessel of darkness had not been swept out and thrown down to the earth, nor swept from the earth and cast outside the region of the worlds into this pit; again the drops of darkness, which will drip down from it, and the torrents that will continue to flow down from above to the earth and assume the trees and all flesh, would have multiplied,
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the application to contemporary human psychology/society beginning with “and the forgetfulness that is in a thousand people today…” as editorial present anchoring.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core mechanics (drips/torrents of darkness affecting trees and flesh) is extended into a ‘today’ comparison—clear application pivot.

paragraphs.core_text: Furthermore, if the fire were in the rulers of the worlds of the heavens until today, and had not been swept out and cast down to the earth, and swept from the earth and shut up inside the vessel of fire that surrounds the worlds; [ ... ] this fire [ ... ... ] above through the torrent [ ... the torrent ... ] below;
paragraphs.temporal_note: Counterfactual cosmological containment logic continues; ‘until today’ may reflect later rhetorical anchoring, but the paragraph remains entirely within cosmic process and elements.

paragraphs.core_text: and the dark fire would have multiplied in the tree and in fruit and in all flesh.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the human/practice application: “The power of the fire that is now in a thousand people… today… You would not have found a single person embracing the fast…” as institutional-ascetic pointing.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Begins with system-internal consequence (dark fire in vegetation/flesh) then shifts to community practice (‘fast’)—a clear late pastoral application.
Meta-discourse in direct address (“Behold, I have taught you…”) functions as editorial/compilation rhetoric rather than impersonal cosmological exposition; no extractable substrate segment.

paragraphs.core_text: The second deed: Al[l] the heavens [ ... / ... ] of the sediment and the pollution [ ... ... ] so that [ ... / ... ] surpasses in them [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Advantages list returns to cosmic purification of heavens/firmaments—system-internal benefit language.

paragraphs.core_text: [The third]: The heavens and the firmaments [ ... / ... b]urden [ ... ] relieved from the weight-carriers [ ... ] and it ceased being heavy. This rich one [ ... ... ] above.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic engineering/purification motif (‘weight-carriers’) is characteristic core cosmography.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth: That they might purify and cleanse their dwelling places [ ... / ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Brief but remains in cosmic domain (dwelling places of heavenly structures).

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth: Because the greatness and the richness that dwells in these ships, as it [ ... ] you might find them living in these ships, purified and holy.
paragraphs.temporal_note: ‘Ships’ here are cosmic vessels/vehicles; descriptive purification goal is internal to the aeonic system.

paragraphs.core_text: The sixth: That you might find the mixed, incomplete, and unconfined temples above at rest and purified; since rest will reach them and pass through them and purify them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: ‘Temples above’ functions as cosmic architecture (not contemporary cult-sites); purification/rest mechanics remain internal.

paragraphs.core_text: The seventh: [ ... ] nature alone of the vessels, which will advance and extend to their places and sites [ ... / ... ] in [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Internal spatial-ordering of vessels (‘places and sites’) continues the cosmic management rationale.

paragraphs.core_text: The eighth: That great enclosures and walls would be made, and confine everything.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Boundary-making (enclosures/walls) is core cosmological containment logic.
Institutional/historical marker ‘apostles’ introduces church-role actors as agents in end-time sign-giving; this crosses from cosmic architecture to community/institutional narrative.

paragraphs.core_text: The tenth deed: That they would become releasers and purifiers of everything at the end of the universe like the fire [ ... / ... ] burns [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Eschatological purification described as cosmic function (‘releasers and purifiers… at the end of the universe’), using elemental fire as internal analogy.

paragraphs.core_text: The eleventh deed: [ ... ] will make a crossing [ ... ] and the entire ruling-power [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Highly lacunose; remaining wording reads like cosmic-eschatological process rather than explicit institutional rule. Classification uncertain but no clear late markers survive.

paragraphs.core_text: to the outer land, for they were not envious of this [ ... ] a man who is richer than them; because the aeons of light are outside [ ... ] the place [ ... ] of peace, the place of honour and grace, the place where the joy of the householders who dwell in it shall never pass away nor recede.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Descriptive cosmography of the outer Land/Aeons of Light; impersonal beatitude-place formulae remain internal to the Light-world.

paragraphs.core_text: The twelfth: That you might find all the deeds of loss hidden from the aeons of light, because of the wall of fire that surrounds the entire building; and these unclean things are displayed (only) in its [ ... ]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Containment-by-boundary (‘wall of fire’) and shielding the Aeons of Light is core architectural cosmology.

paragraphs.core_text: There was a need for these twelve great deeds because the vessels that were discharged and swept out from the firmaments to the earth, and were also swept from the earth to the extr[emity) ... / ... ] the three words of life watch over them that [ ... / ... ar]e set over them in great power [ ... ] that they might watch over them at the last time; because of this, they are firmly set thus in these fetters,

paragraphs.temporal_note: Mostly core: cosmic rationale, guardianship (‘three words of life’), fetters/bound containment; ends with a compiler-style first-person reminder indicating a later rhetorical layer.
